text: When his parents are in error, the son must remonstrate with them with respect and gently. If they do not receive his reproof, he must strive more and more to be dutiful and respectful towards them till they are pleased, and then he must again point out their fault.
author: Confucius and Zengzi
speaker: Quoted from the Li Chi (Book of Rites)
reference: The Classic of Filial Piety (Xiao Jing)
locator: Introduction, III. Filial Duty and Parental Love
